timelines.title: Ration Task Turns Violent; Mary Kom Slips
timelines.message: Aggressive ration/captaincy task. Contestants clash over food. Mary Kom slips and falls. Love Gill explodes at Yung DSA. Qazi-Yung fight continues. Mahhi and Uditi win a ration round. Bigg Boss flags rule breaks by Gullu, Yung and Mary. Season still ongoing.

timelines.title: Gullu Restores Two Lifelines
timelines.message: Captain Gullu is offered 120% ration with no lifeline restore, or 80% ration plus restoring two lives. He chooses 80% ration and restores Uditi Singh and Kanika Mann’s lost lifelines.

timelines.title: Week 4 Pair Nomination: 11 in Danger
timelines.message: Pairs must pick who gets nominated. Mahhi nominates herself to save Arishfa. Scout nominates himself to save Aasif. Aman-Kanika, Qazi-Uditi, and Yung-Love-Mary fail to agree, so all of them go up. Safe: Gullu, Arishfa, Aasif. Nominated: Rhiti, Amrapali, Mahhi, Scout, Qazi, Uditi, Aman, Kanika, Yung DSA, Love Gill, Mary Kom.

timelines.title: Isha Rikhi Evicted
timelines.message: Weekend Ka Vaar Day 21. Isha and Yung DSA were Week 3 nominees. Salman teases Yung’s exit, then reveals Isha got fewer public votes. Second full eviction after Rohed. Salman: ‘Well played, Isha. You kept your dignity.’ House now at 14.

timelines.title: Star-Studded Weekend Ka Vaar
timelines.message: Ajay Devgn and Jaideep Ahlawat promote Drishyam: The Conclusion. Fatima Sana Shaikh, Raghubir Yadav and Mohammed Zeeshan Ayyub promote Hunkkaar. Salman slams paparazzi and AI deepfake video creators. Rhiti Tiwari breaks down; Mahhi and Kanika console her.

timelines.title: Gullu Wins Captaincy Again
timelines.message: Second straight captaincy for Kushal Tanwar aka Gullu, beating Mary Kom and Love Gill. Captaincy task is physical and messy. Qazi vs Yung DSA fight. Rhiti is knocked out of the race. Arishfa vs Kanika tension continues.

timelines.title: Rhiti Loses House Support
timelines.message: Rhiti struggles to gather backing for captaincy. Gullu’s group prefers Mary Kom. Pair captaincy rounds eliminate Rhiti. Qazi later apologizes to Yung for hurting him; Yung rejects it and the fight resumes.

timelines.title: Rohed Khan Evicted
timelines.message: First full walk-out of the season. Rohed, Aasif and Scout were directly nominated after discussing nominations with Yung. Public votes send Rohed out on Day 14. Aasif and Scout survive.

timelines.title: Gullu Becomes Week 2 Captain
timelines.message: White Room captaincy: men in white, women throw colour at men they do not want as captain. Least-painted Gullu wins. Scout loses a lifeline in the process. Yung’s first captaincy ends.

timelines.title: Nominations Voided After Rule Break
timelines.message: Housemates nominate in Room 20, then Bigg Boss cancels those names. Aasif, Rohed and Scout are directly nominated for discussing nominations with captain Yung DSA. Yung is spared because he is outgoing captain.

timelines.title: Uditi Loses a Lifeline, Not the House
timelines.message: First Weekend Ka Vaar. Uditi Singh gets the fewest votes among Kanika, Arishfa, Love and Uditi. Tathas-two twist: she is not evicted; she burns one of two lives. Salman tells her the show is not for staying quiet. Amrapali–Arishfa clash continues on stage.

timelines.title: Yung DSA Named First Captain
timelines.message: Movie Theatre popcorn task. Housemates dump popcorn into buckets of Aasif, Gullu or Yung. Yung DSA wins first captaincy. Mahhi is sanchalak.

timelines.title: 2X Room Steals Lifelines
timelines.message: Captain nominees enter Room 2X. Door 2 would add a life; Door X removes one. All three must take a life: Aasif takes Arishfa’s, Gullu takes Uditi’s, Yung takes Kanika’s. Because Yung then wins captaincy, Kanika is confirmed down one life.

timelines.title: First Nominations
timelines.message: Open-style nominations. Final danger list: Kanika Mann, Uditi Singh, Arishfa Khan, Love Gill. Love gets the most names. Arishfa fights Amrapali after being called a ‘kid’.

timelines.title: Kanika’s First Power Play
timelines.message: Bigg Boss asks Kanika to name the housemate she dislikes most. She picks Qazi Touqeer. Qazi is barred from the captaincy task and made sanchalak of Happy Birthday Bigg Boss cake task. Aasif, Gullu and Yung qualify for captaincy.

timelines.title: House Settles In; Duality Theme Live
timelines.message: Wonderland house in Film City: teapot throne, BB Food Truck kitchen, shark pool, Room 20 and secret Room 2X. Every contestant starts with two lives (Vardaan / Tathas-two). Fake first-night ‘eliminate one’ joke is revealed as a prank.

timelines.title: 16 Contestants Enter
timelines.message: Confirmed house: Kanika Mann, Aasif Khan, Qazi Touqeer, Isha Rikhi, Amrapali Dubey, Rohed Khan, Mary Kom, Yung DSA (Harsh Machare), Love Gill, Tanmay ScoutOP Singh, Arishfa Khan, Aman Gandhi, Uditi Singh, Rhiti Tiwari, Kushal Gullu Tanwar, Mahhi Vij.

timelines.title: Fans Ka Faisla: Love In, Rhiya Out
timelines.message: Love Gill beats Rhiya Ahir in the pre-premiere fan vote and enters. Rhiya is eliminated on launch night without entering the main house.

timelines.title: Bigg Boss 20 Grand Premiere
timelines.message: Salman Khan hosts Season 20 (Tathas-two / Tathastu) on JioHotstar at 9 PM and Colors TV at 10:30 PM. Chess metaphor for strategy. He performs hit songs. Theme: two lives, Extra Jeevan Daan, hidden Room 20. Digital-first 20th-anniversary season launched with other language editions the same weekend.
